hero_title: Kukusagika omu rugendo rwawe orwa dijitali
hero_subtitle: Yega, Tunga, Oikale kandi Oikale noosiima — omuhanda gwawe ogw'okutunga emigisa gutandikira hanu.
tip_save: Wahura hakiri ebicweka ikumi ha kikumi ebya entaahya yaawe buli wiiki — entaito zikura bwangu!
tip_sacco: Yeteranize ha kitebe ky'okwahura sente (SACCO) ekiri omu kiikaro kyanyu kutunga looni n'okwombeka ebyafaayo byawe eby'okusasura.
tip_photos: Teera ebisisani by'ebintu byawe omu musana gw'obuhangwa habw'okutunda kurungi ha mitimbagano.
tip_water: Nywa haakiri egiraasi 8 ez'amaizi bulikiro habw'obwomeezi oburungi n'amaani.
tip_digital: Kora ekintu ekihyaka eky'okukozesa kompyuta buli wiiki — okukora ekintu buli kaire nikukira okukora juba.
welcome_desc: Omunywani waawe ow'omu bya kalimagezi ow'okwega, okukora sente, kukura, n'okweyongera kukuraakurana. Akora ha mitimbagano n'obu etaroho — okukurakurana kwawe buli kaire kuba kurungi.
about_you_desc: Kinu kitukoonyera kumanya ebirukukukwataho n'okutunga emigisa n'ebintu ebirukukwataho.
cat_digital_desc: Kompyuta, intaneeti, n’ebikwato by’okukozesa ha simu
cat_leadership_desc: Obwebembezi bw’ekyaro n’emyoga y’okurwanirra ebirukukwata ha bantu
sell_products_desc: Kwatagana n’abaguzi omu kyaro kyawe n’okukiraho. Handiika ebintu byawe, teekaho emihendo, kandi okanye omulimo gwawe.
popular_products_desc: Ebintu ebirukumanywa kuruga omu bakazi abali omu kiikaro kyawe
listing_title_hint: e.g. Emboga z'omu misiri ezitali z'okwokya.
no_listings_yet: Tihakabaireho bikwato - beeraho w’okubanza kutaho ekintu
share_knowledge_desc: Konyera abakazi abandi kukura kuraba omu kubagabira amagezi gaawe n’obumanyirizi bwawe. Okuba mentor guli gumu ha bintu ebikuru ebi osobora kukora.
your_health_matters_desc: Funa amakuru agarukirwamu agarukukwata ha by'obwomeezi kandi oteeranize n'obuheereza omu kiikaro kyanyu.
maternal_health_desc: Enda, obujanjabi hanyuma y'okuzaara, n'okubalirra oruzaaro
mental_wellness_desc: Okurwanisa okweralikirra, okwerolerra, n'obusagiki omu biteekerezo
nearby_services_sub: Ebyoma by'obwomeezi n'obuheereza omu kiikaro kyanyu
ai_greeting: Oraire ota? Ninyowe omukoonyezi wa AI kuruga omu AI Connect Africa. Ninsobora kukukoonyera n'amagezi agarukukwata ha by'obusuubuzi, obukugu omu kulima, amakuru agarukukwata ha by'obwomeezi, obuhabuzi obukwatiraine n'esente, hamu n'ebindi bingi. Nooyenda kumanya ki?
chat_connection_error: Titusobole kuhikirra omukoonyezi. Bambi gezaho ogarukemu bwangu.
windows_recaptcha_note: Ha Windows, noosobora kurora omu bwire butaito ekicweka ky'okukebera nga code ya OTP tekasindikirwe.
__literal_23: Sika omulimo gwawe obu oli ha mitimbagano
__literal_29: Funa ebirango ha migisa n’ebikukwataho abantu
__literal_31: Ebihandiiko n’ebikukwataho kuruga omu bitebe byawe
__literal_124: Obukodyo bw’okurwanisa okweralikirra n’okutuntura buli kiro
__literal_78: Teekaho CV eyekikugu erukwoleka obukugu bwawe n'obumanyirivu bwawe. AI-assisted — garukamu ebikaguzo bike.
__literal_82: Enteekaniza z'okutendeka ez'okwongera ha mirimo yaawe n'eby'obusuubuzi.
__literal_86: Esimu, intaneeti, hamu na kompyuta ez'okubanza
language_selection_help: Koma orulimi orw’ogonza kukozesa omu app
otp_send_failed: Tikisobole kusindika code. Bambi gezaho bundi.
otp_verify_failed: Koodi egi ekalemwa kukora. Bambi gezaho bundi.
role_leader_desc: Ninyebembera rundi nteekaniza omu kyaro kyange
ai_learning_desc: Kagwize ekikaguzo kyona otunge obukoonyezi ahonaaho
ask_ai_assistant_desc: Funa eby'okugarukamu ebikuhikire ha by'obusuubuzi, obulimi, eby'obwomeezi, n'ebindi
grow_with_guidance_desc: Buli mukazi w'obusinguzi akaba aine omuntu ayamwikiririzamu. Serra omuntu akwegese rundi obe omu.
find_mentor_desc: Kwatagana n'abakazi abamazire obwire bwingi omu mulimo abasobora kukwebembera
become_mentor_desc: Gabana obumanyi bwawe kandi oyimuse abandi
__literal_4: Tikisobole kwiha orulimi runu. Kebera intaneeti yaawe ogezeemu.
__literal_47: Serra ebitebe by’okwahura n’ebitebe by’abantu abeeteeraine ebiri haihi naiwe
__literal_49: Yega kusindika, kutunga, n’okwahura na mobile money
__literal_52: Ebikwato n’ebintu ebirukusobora kukukoonyera kwebiikira, kutegeka embalirra, n’okukuraakuraniza sente zaawe.
__literal_54: N’okubiika 500 UGX buli kiro nikyongera obwire obu kuhinguraho
__literal_56: Manya nambere sente zaawe zirukugenda buli sabiiti
__literal_58: Okwahura kw'ekitebe kukukoonyera kutunga looni n’obusagiki
__literal_96: Yegaite ha bitebe by'abakazi omu kicweka kyanyu
__literal_98: Ebiri ha mpero kuruga omu bakazi omu kibanja kyawe
__literal_100: Kwataniza n'ebitebe by'abakazi, mugabane ebi murabiremu, musagike buli omu, kandi mukurane hamu.
__literal_102: Yegaite ha kitebe ekiri hansi rundi otandike ekyawe
role_artisan_desc: Nkora ebintu ebikozirwe n'emikono rundi eby'emikono
__literal_113: Mazire kumara omusomo gwa Digital Skills! Ninsemerra orugendo runu.
__literal_114: Eby'obusuubuzi byange eby'okubaza ebibbo bitungire ekiragiro ky'okubiguza omu bwingi kiro kinu!
__literal_115: Ninserra abakazi abarukugonza kukora SACCO omu disiturikiti ya Gulu.
__literal_130: Obu oraaba nooyetaaga obukoonyezi, rundi haroho omuntu ondi ou orukumanya arukwetaaga obukoonyezi, obukoonyezi oburukwesigwa buroho.
__literal_133: Obu haraaba haroho akabi ak'ahonaaho rundi akabi ak'ebigwererezi
__literal_137: Omuntu ow'omuka yaawe, munywani, rundi omwebembezi w'ekicweka asobora kukukoonyera kutunga obukoonyezi bw'omu kicweka n'obu haakuba hataroho enamba ya simu ey'okukubungira.
__literal_138: Obu oraaba oli omu kabi ak'ahonaaho, hikiriza obuheereza obw'ebigwererezi hati.
knowledge_is_power_desc: Amasomo agarukukwata ha bintu ebikozesebwa omu bwomeezi bwabulikiro agateekanizibwe habw'abakazi — kuruga ha bukugu omu bya kalimagezi kuhika ha kwebembera emirimo y’entaahya, byona omu rulimi rwawe.
practical_skills_sub: Obukugu obw'okukozesa omu bwomeezi bwa bulikiro.
__literal_65: Rambura emirimo, emirimo ey'okwekorra, n'enteekaniza z'okutendekwa kuruga omu bakozesa abahamiibwe.
__literal_69: Omukoonyezi w'okuranga ha byoma bya kalimagezi.
__literal_120: Eby'okwekoonyera, obusagiki omu nyehurra, n'okwombeka amaani g'okugumisiriza.
